testcase.name: published seconds remain compatible with repository and legacy suggestions
conflicting duplicates never choose an arbitrary personal override
only liturgy has a supported player and invalid neighboring data is skipped
missing known beginning offers service without inventing stage
old month and weekday are never recycled as a future service
multiple published starts select latest plausible current and nearest future
exhausted current guide and next known service are independent choices
spring DST gap and autumn DST overlap never get guessed
duplicated published instant keeps the same identity across the start boundary
personal time overrides only the suggestion for its parish and date
exact start enters current and 150 minute boundary is inclusive
a future published period can be shown before it begins
parish timezone determines the instant independently of fixed clock zone
current may cross parish midnight and retains its service date
each published event must lie within its own valid period
next service spans days and months without a two hour cutoff
invalid personal records do not hide published services
custom parish can use one explicit personal start without published validity dates
